**Release Notes**

- **#1551**: feat(OMN-14750) backfills `agent_source` on `ModelClaudeCodeHookEvent` and retypes `Cursor` from `str` to `EnumAgentSource` (str-accepting validator). First half of the OMN-14749 parity seam; wire shape unchanged.

- **#1690**: fix(OMN-18205) corrects Receipt Gate's untrusted test routing. Previously sent all PR events to untrusted public runners; now distinguishes same-repo PRs (trusted) from fork PRs (untrusted).

- **#1262**: feat(OMN-13249) adds structural `agent_invocation` carve-out for canonical-inference gate. Permits model-CLI subprocesses only when enclosing `contract.yaml` declares `descriptor.agent_invocation: true`, verified via `find_enclosing_contract` + `contract_permits_agent_invocation`.

- **#1430**: feat(OMN-14350) introduces non-canonical lifecycle-class ratchet gate (canary: `omnibase_core` only). AST allowlist-ratchet flags new CamelCase classes with non-canonical lifecycle type-words (Service, Engine, Adapter, etc.) outside frozen per-repo baseline.

- **#1723**: fix(OMN-18882) makes Receipt Gate accept dependency-pin-only outcomes. Gate now consults `occ-autobind / outcome` check-run; previously failed such PRs because producer declines to mint companion for diffs with no behavioural claim.
